annotations.title: How to watch NBA Finals 2026: Free streams, schedule, TV channels for New York Knicks vs San Antonio Spurs
New York Knicks 2026 Home Game Schedule & Tickets | Ticketmaster

content.text:
The **next NBA game appears to be NBA Finals Game 3: San Antonio Spurs at New York Knicks**, on **Monday, June 8, 2026 at 8:30 p.m. ET**, at **Madison Square Garden**. ([techradar.com](https://www.techradar.com/how-to-watch/basketball/nba-finals-2026-free-streams-new-york-knicks-vs-san-antonio-spurs?utm_source=openai))

Best places to get tickets:

1. **Ticketmaster** — the primary/official ticketing marketplace for many NBA tickets; the Knicks Ticketmaster page lists upcoming Finals games at Madison Square Garden. ([ticketmaster.ca](https://www.ticketmaster.ca/new-york-knicks-tickets/artist/805988?home_away=home&utm_source=openai))  
2. **NBA.com Finals page** — good starting point for official schedule and ticket links. ([nba.com](https://www.nba.com/playoffs/2026/nba-finals?lid=2e9um7gj9367&utm_source=openai))  
3. **Verified resale marketplaces** — StubHub, SeatGeek, Vivid Seats, Gametime, etc. Compare total price after fees before buying.

Quick tip: because this is the **NBA Finals**, prices may be very high and inventory can change fast. Make sure the listing says **Game 3 / Spurs at Knicks / June 8, 2026 / Madison Square Garden** before purchasing.
